# `ResourceReadContext`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\ResourceReadContext`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Interceptor/ResourceReadContext.php)

Everything an interceptor may inspect about one resources/read: the
requested URI, the variables extracted from a resource template (empty
for a static resource), the template the URI matched (null for a static
resource), the MCP session and the client identity resolved by
\Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\SharedSecretMiddleware (never the raw secret).

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|---|---|---|
| `uri` | `string` | yes |
| `variables` | `array` | yes |
| `uriTemplate` | `?string` | yes |
| `session` | `?Mcp\Server\Session\SessionInterface` | yes |
| `clientId` | `?string` | yes |
